name: Pirate Lords of Love
source:
Your life in a seaside town has been peaceful but dull—until an infamous, wealthy samurai suitor approaches you one day and asks for your hand in marriage. As a wedding gift, he gives you a magnificent black pearl necklace. After your father dies of a sudden illness, distant relatives eagerly arrange the union, despite your misgivings.

When an impressive vessel, the Narukami Trade Ship, docks in the port on the morning of your wedding, you realize you have one chance to escape. You cut your hair, don male attire, and set sail in search of freedom and a new life...

However, little do you know that this "merchant vessel" is also flying false colors. It's actually a pirate ship belonging to the infamous Minakami Kaizoku, a clan of seafaring warriors called the lords of the sea. These deadly, rich rogues plunder and raid wherever they sail, and their ship strikes fear into the hearts of any she approaches.

In for a penny, in for a pound. You're already on the open sea with these dangerous men, and it's too late to turn back now. It's said that pirate crews are usually close, but it seems some crewmates are interested in more than just usual comradery with you… How long can you keep your secret among this gang of handsome sailors, and what will happen if it's found out? Worst of all, will your scorned fiancé let you escape so easily?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.japanesepirate]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你在海边小镇的生活平静而乏味——直到有一天，一位臭名昭著、富有的武士追求者走近你，向你求婚。作为结婚礼物，他送给你一条华丽的黑珍珠项链。你的父亲突发疾病去世后，远房亲戚不顾你的疑虑，急切地安排了结合。

当一艘令人印象深刻的船只，鸣神商船，在你婚礼的早晨停靠在港口时，你意识到你有一次逃脱的机会。你剪掉头发，穿上男装，扬帆起航，寻找自由和新生活……

然而殊不知，这艘“商船”也满面虚伪。它实际上是一艘海盗船，属于臭名昭著的水上海族，这是一个被称为海洋之王的航海武士氏族。这些致命而富有的盗贼所到之处都会进行掠夺和袭击，他们的船让任何靠近的人都感到恐惧。

一分钱，一英镑。你已经和这些危险的人一起在公海上了，现在回头已经太晚了。据说海盗船员们通常都很亲密，但似乎有些船员对你的兴趣不仅仅是平常的友情……你能在这帮英俊的水手中保守你的秘密多久，如果被发现会发生什么？最糟糕的是，你那被鄙视的未婚夫会让你轻易逃脱吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.japanesepirate]Google Play[/url]]
